description: Assign one or more travelers to one or more segments in a single call. To put the same travelers on several segments (for example every flight of a trip), pass all of them in segment_ids and all travelers in traveler_ids in one call instead of one call per segment. Up to 50 segments and 50 travelers per call, and at most 200 segment-traveler pairs. Assigning an already-assigned traveler is a no-op, and each segment succeeds or fails on its own: the result lists what was assigned and, per segment, what failed and why.

segment_id.description: One segment ID to assign travelers to. Use segment_ids for several.

segment_ids.description: Segment IDs to assign the same travelers to, in one call.

traveler_id.description: One trip traveler ID to assign. Use traveler_ids for several.

traveler_ids.description: Trip traveler IDs (from trip_travelers) to assign to every listed segment.

name: traveler_assign
title: Assign traveler to itinerary item
